draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
revised_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base extends to the held-out Insurance, Telecom and Utilities domains (85.7 vs 81.2, 83.9 vs 80.4, and 86.2 vs 82.0 macro-F1, respectively).
rationale: T1.r3-r5 show Wrenfold exceeds Fennick-Base on all three held-out domains (85.7>81.2, 83.9>80.4, 86.2>82.0). The evidence supports a definite claim of extension to these evaluated domains, not merely a hedged "may extend."
